cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on Deployment in Amazon SageMaker.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 Amazon SageMaker 部署實作。

cues.en: So even though we already did the cleanup of all our SageMaker resources in the previous section, I have just recreated everything so that I can show you how to deploy some models,
cues.zh: 雖然上一節清理過全部資源，我又重新建立，方便展示部署，

cues.en: and we'll deploy the exact same models we built in the previous section here in Canvas.
cues.zh: 會部署上一節 Canvas 建的相同兩個模型。

cues.en: Therefore, I would recommend only watching this tutorial unless you really wanna do it with me, in which case you would have to reproduce what we did in the previous section,
cues.zh: 因此建議先觀看，除非真的想跟著做，就需要重做上一節，

cues.en: which actually would be great practice.
cues.zh: 其實也是很好的練習。

cues.en: Okay, so up to you.
cues.zh: 自行決定。

cues.en: And now here we go, let's start again from where we left things in the previous section right before the cleanup, meaning having our two machine learning models, the regression model and the classification model.
cues.zh: 從上一節清理前的位置開始，有迴歸與分類兩個模型。

cues.en: Okay, so we'll deploy these two, starting with the regression model.
cues.zh: 先部署迴歸。

cues.en: All right, so these are the different versions of the model, and we only had one version v1, so I'm gonna click on this one, v1.
cues.zh: 這裡是不同版本，目前只有 V1，點它。

cues.en: And remember these were the results with an excellent R squared of 0.97 as well as a very low RMSE of 2.943.
cues.zh: 記得結果很好，R 平方 0.97、RMSE 2.943 很低。

cues.en: So we have a good model here and now we want to deploy it so that then we can reuse it in another application thanks to what we call an endpoint.
cues.zh: 模型很好，現在部署，透過端點在另一個應用重用。

cues.en: So you will see actually the deployment here will create an endpoint which we'll be able to find in our SageMaker domain and then reuse it whenever we want to make new predictions.
cues.zh: 部署會建立端點，可在 SageMaker 網域找到，之後用來做新預測。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go, let's deploy this.
cues.zh: 開始部署。

cues.en: Remember in the previous section, we did predict step and the deployment comes right after the predict step here in Deploy.
cues.zh: 上一節做 Predict，後面就是 Deploy。

cues.en: If you get this, the fact that you don't have permission to deploy models, please contact your administrator for support, well, no worries, we don't have to contact our administrator for support,
cues.zh: 如果看到沒有部署權限、請聯絡管理員，不用擔心，這裡不必聯絡，

cues.en: it's just a setting that we can configure in our user profile.
cues.zh: 只是使用者設定檔內可設定的選項。

cues.en: And to do so, you go to your user profile, then you go to App configurations here, then you scroll down, you scroll down to Canvas, there we go,
cues.zh: 到設定檔、App configurations，往下到 Canvas，

cues.en: then you're gonna click Edit at the top right.
cues.zh: 按右上 Edit。

cues.en: There we go, that brings us to the Canvas settings.
cues.zh: 進 Canvas 設定。

cues.en: Then we're gonna scroll down all the way to the bottom in ML Ops configuration, and there we go, that's what we have to enable
cues.zh: 往下到最底 MLOps configuration，要啟用這個，

cues.en: so that we can indeed directly deploy our Canvas models.
cues.zh: 才能直接部署 Canvas 模型。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this, let's click Submit and user profile was updated successfully, perfect.
cues.zh: 按 Submit，設定檔更新成功，很好。

cues.en: And so now let's go back to Canvas, let's refresh this.
cues.zh: 回 Canvas，重新整理。

cues.en: And normally we should see that in blue.
cues.zh: 應該會變成藍色。

cues.en: Let's see, let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: And there we go, the blue button is now here.
cues.zh: 好了，藍按鈕出現。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go, let's click + Create Deployment.
cues.zh: 按 + Create deployment。

cues.en: Deployment type, Real-time.
cues.zh: 部署類型選 Real-time，即即時推論。

cues.en: Deployment name, well, let's specify that it's the regression new deployment.
cues.zh: 名稱設為 regression-new-deployment。

cues.en: Okay, then for the instance type, even though it's quite tempting to choose the recommended option, well, our dataset is super small and also for cost optimization purposes,
cues.zh: Instance type 雖然很想選推薦，但資料很小，也為了降低成本，

cues.en: we're gonna use the smallest instance, which would be the first one here, ml.t2.medium.
cues.zh: 用最小的，第一個 ml.t2.medium。

cues.en: Okay, and we will definitely not need two instances, but just one so that will be fine.
cues.zh: 不需兩個執行個體，一個就好。

cues.en: All right, so there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: We can go with this.
cues.zh: 就用這樣。

cues.en: Let's click Deploy.
cues.zh: 按 Deploy。

cues.en: And congratulations, you have just deployed your very first machinery model in Canvas.
cues.zh: 恭喜，剛部署了第一個 Canvas 機器學習模型。

cues.en: As you can see, regression model was deployed, View deployment, and you will see now all the details of your deployment.
cues.zh: 顯示 Regression model was deployed，按 View deployment 查看細節。

cues.en: It's actually creating right now, as you can see, and well, that's the deployment name we just chose, well, actually canvas-regression-new-deployment, created today,
cues.zh: 實際上仍在建立，這是剛選的名稱 canvas-regression-new-deployment，今天建立，

cues.en: and instance type, we chose the smallest one.
cues.zh: 執行個體選最小。

cues.en: Deployment URL, that's the one that's gonna be the URL of your endpoint, meaning the model deployed in the form of an endpoint
cues.zh: Deployment URL，就是端點網址，部署模型成為端點，

cues.en: which you can access then to reuse in a new application.
cues.zh: 之後可存取、用於新應用。

cues.en: Deployment type, Real-time.
cues.zh: 類型 Real-time。

cues.en: And of course, we deployed our regression model, actually the first version v1 of our regression model.
cues.zh: 部署的是迴歸模型第一版 V1。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go, let's just wait for the status to be created and I'll see you in a couple of seconds.
cues.zh: 等待完成，幾秒後見。

cues.en: And here we go, our model is now deployed.
cues.zh: 好了，已部署。

cues.en: As you can see, this status is now in service.
cues.zh: 狀態 In service。

cues.en: And also, if you noticed, we are no longer in the My Models feature of Canvas, we're now in ML Ops, you know, for ML operations.
cues.zh: 如果注意到，現在不是 My models，而是 MLOps，機器學習維運。

cues.en: And so there we go, now our regression model is successfully deployed.
cues.zh: 迴歸部署成功。

cues.en: Great, now I'm just gonna do the same super quickly for our classification model.
cues.zh: 快速對分類做同樣事情。

cues.en: So here, I'm gonna click View again, then I'm gonna go to the v1 version, then I'm gonna go to Deploy.
cues.zh: 按 View，進 V1，再 Deploy。

cues.en: And once again I'm gonna create a new deployment, I'm gonna call it this time, of course, classification-new-deployment.
cues.zh: 再建新部署，當然命名 classification-new-deployment。

cues.en: Then same, we'll use the smallest instance, also the cheapest one, ml.t2.medium, and we're gonna use only one instance.
cues.zh: 同樣最小、最便宜 ml.t2.medium，只用一個。

cues.en: All right, here we go, let's click Deploy to deploy indeed our classification model.
cues.zh: 按 Deploy，部署分類。

cues.en: And again, this will take a bit of time.
cues.zh: 需要一點時間。

cues.en: We will be taken once again to the ML Ops feature if we click here, View deployment.
cues.zh: 按 View deployment，再次進 MLOps。

cues.en: And there we go, now our classification model is being deployed and it will take another few minutes so I'll see you very soon once it's ready.
cues.zh: 分類部署中，還要幾分鐘，完成再見。

cues.en: And here we go, our classification model is now well deployed, the status is in service.
cues.zh: 好了，分類也部署，In service。

cues.en: And so congratulations, you have just deployed two machine learning models.
cues.zh: 恭喜，部署兩個模型。

cues.en: And if you wanna see the deployments, you just have to click ML Ops here and then go to Deployments where you will see your two deployed models, the one for regression and the one for classification.
cues.zh: 要查看，按 MLOps、Deployments，就有迴歸與分類。

cues.en: All right, so mission accomplished.
cues.zh: 任務完成。

cues.en: We'll leave things here in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂先到這裡。

cues.en: And of course in the next hands-on tutorials, I'll show you how to reuse your deployed models for different purposes, so I can't wait to see you there, and until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 後續會展示如何為不同用途重用已部署模型，期待見到你，在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
